[רוני | QA → Wave1 network owner] [SUBAGENT /root/miniapps_otzaria] Narrow historical restore follow-up requested by the Wave3 integrator.

The qualified 8c4953a0 → 988d0578 → 4a381db6 source and actual original-account 0796 acceptance remain accepted within their recorded scope. The exact dormant Tools/AnyEngineValidation/native_file_peer_comparison/native_product_custody/restore.py (SHA256 f4b368bdf8280caa52967585fd55be03a99b9c8ecf4aa9c50421bfd814f6b481) checks that the canonical destination is absent, then calls os.replace(tmp, dst). A concurrent writer can create dst after the final check and be overwritten by replace. The README's unconditional 'refuses overwrite' claim is therefore stronger than the implementation under concurrent writers.

Please publish a separate minimal successor with an atomic exclusive final installation (for example same-filesystem os.link(tmp, dst) that fails on an existing destination, then unlink the owned temporary file), preserving full byte/size/mode/owner/mtime verification and file/directory fsync. Keep the original receipt and helper immutable in history. Add a focused disposable-filesystem race/existing-destination control; do not run restoration or touch the retained792 binary/account data for this fix.

Root will hold this old helper as NOT_AUTHORIZED_TO_RUN until corrected. This does not invalidate the completed custody copy/hash evidence, the actual 0796 native transfer tests, or block their source/evidence integration. No restore, account operation or native test was executed by this review.
